caption: The drawing features a landscape with a beige background and a wavy strip of green, blue, brown, and pink along the bottom, representing undulating ground. On the left, there is a tree with brown branches and sparse green leaves. Next to the tree, a blue bird is perched on a branch. Moving right, there is a smaller plant with curving, slender stems and pink flowers with green leaves. Toward the center, a taller plant displays rounded clusters of blue and purple fruits or berries, along with large green and yellow leaves. Continuing to the right, there are additional flowers in shades of yellow, blue, and pink, with curling stems and varied leaves. On the far right, a large blue bird with a light blue head and chest sits on the low ground beside blue and yellow flowers. The entire composition is rendered in muted, pastel tones, primarily using shades of green, blue, brown, yellow, pink, and purple on a plain, unadorned ground.
title: Crewel Embroidery Valance
